_comment: Template for Configuration/BrandRenameApproval.local.json. The .local.json file is gitignored: it records a human decision, not a project artifact. Two independent gates read it — see Scripts/check-brand-clearance.sh.

_gates.engineering: engineeringRenameApproved must be true AND approvedByHuman must be true. Allows the local technical rename (code, docs, assets, bundle id, data migration).
_gates.publication: legalReviewStatus must be 'accepted' AND publicReleaseAllowed must be true. Allows public release, push, deployment, tags, and any outward-facing artifact.
